paragraphs.source_en: While Ōkurakyō-no-Tsubone and Shōei-ni were fearfully making their way to Sunpu, Katagiri Katsumoto had already taken lodging at Tokuganji Temple in Mariko and was awaiting Ieyasu’s stern interrogation. As always, Katsumoto requested an audience with Ieyasu the moment he reached Tokuganji, but by late that night the only person to visit him was Honda Masazumi, who came alone; this left Katsumoto more alarmed than ever.

units.source_en: As always, Katsumoto requested an audience with Ieyasu the moment he reached Tokuganji, but by late that night the only person to visit him was Honda Masazumi, who came alone; this left Katsumoto more alarmed than ever.
units.source_zh: 此次也和往常一样，一到德愿寺，且元就迫不及待提出谒见家康的请求，但直至当日深夜，他等来的只是本多正纯的独自造访，这让且元愈发惊慌。

paragraphs.source_zh: 且说大藏局和正荣尼惶恐赶奔骏府时，片桐且元已住进鞠子德愿寺，等待接受家康那严厉的盘诘。此次也和往常一样，一到德愿寺，且元就迫不及待提出谒见家康的请求，但直至当日深夜，他等来的只是本多正纯的独自造访，这让且元愈发惊慌。

paragraphs.source_en: “The Retired Shogun says that meeting Lord Ichi-no-kami would serve no purpose. What agreement, precisely, exists between you and the Retired Shogun?” Masazumi himself appeared deeply perplexed.

units.source_en: “The Retired Shogun says that meeting Lord Ichi-no-kami would serve no purpose.

units.source_en: Masazumi himself appeared deeply perplexed.

paragraphs.source_zh: “大御所大人吩咐，即使和市正大人会面也无济于事。大人和大御所之间究竟有何约定？”正纯也似十分困惑。

paragraphs.source_en: “Do you mean that His Lordship will not take me to see the Retired Shogun?”

units.source_en: “Do you mean that His Lordship will not take me to see the Retired Shogun?”

paragraphs.source_zh: “大人的意思，是不引在下去见大御所大人？”

paragraphs.source_en: “His Lordship said that he does not wish to see you; that Ichi-no-kami has fulfilled none of his promises thus far, and that he was mistaken in the man. That was all he said.”

units.source_en: “His Lordship said that he does not wish to see you; that Ichi-no-kami has fulfilled none of his promises thus far, and that he was mistaken in the man.

paragraphs.source_en: Honda Masazumi’s lucid words drove into Katsumoto’s breast like a huge nail. Katsumoto could only answer, “Yes.” But what was to become of the Great Buddha dedication and the sixteenth-anniversary memorial? Did Lord Ieyasu believe that a war between east and west was now unavoidable?

paragraphs.source_en: “Oh?” Masazumi looked somewhat surprised. “For you to say that you are fully convinced yet still regretful is exceedingly strange.”

paragraphs.source_en: “Oh? Was the inscription on that bell a riddle posed to the Minister of the Right?”

paragraphs.source_en: “Precisely. I believe that the Minister of the Right has become a worthy head of the Toyotomi house. By posing this riddle, the Retired Shogun must intend to see how he disciplines himself and governs his household, and to measure the breadth of his capacity.”

paragraphs.source_en: Throughout the sixth day of the eighth month, Katsumoto’s thoughts ran wild, and in the end he still did not visit Masazumi. He was being deliberately challenged, and fear had already taken possession of him, leaving him no room to attend to anything else.

paragraphs.source_en: On the morning of the seventh, he resolved to dispense with notifying Masazumi and force his way directly into Sunpu’s main castle, there to petition Ieyasu once more for Hideyori and the Toyotomi house. Otherwise, even if he died, he would be too ashamed to face the Taikō!
